report.reading_scope:
Read the entire publisher HTML mathematical body, §§1–4.3, all displayed mathematics, footnotes 1–8, acknowledgments and bibliography [1]–[81], in overlapping section-sized retrievals. Publisher PDF located and its opening copyright/license text checked. No full source-PDF pixel inspection claimed.
Read PDF text pp1–6, pp21–40, pp45–49, p50 through the opening portion of Example 3.8, and pp53–56. The pp32–40 extraction was initially truncated in its middle; pp35–38 were reread separately. This covers the introductory theorem contracts, geometrical/coefficient/zero-frequency/nonlinear/data/solution assumptions, recurrence and renormalized radiation fields, Main Theorems 1–3, selected flat/potential/dynamic examples, Schwarzschild and beginning Kerr–Newman examples, nonlinear examples at p53, and the statement and argument of Theorem 4.1. Page56 also includes the opening of §5.1.1. These selected ranges do not constitute reading the full 180-page paper.

482B.scope: r^-1 球谐分离及有效势全部计算，区分 μ=0 与 μ>0；不声明精确 massive 尾指数。

482C.scope: 半径为 <y>/4 的局部 Sobolev 缩放、加权向量场迭代及质量通量代入。

482D.scope: Fourier L¹ 的 Schwarz 估计、径向可积性、反演与支配收敛，再用加权 L² 逼近和 Plancherel。

482E.scope: 带 φ² 的收缩球能量、局部有界系数与积分因子，覆盖势和质量项。
